answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Social-graph flow limits: each identity may endorse only 6 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 340 aliases need 340 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches. A cluster that endorses only itself collapses to a single share. The ridge of the design is public, the canyon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the saffron of honest work is what finally pays. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
